$comment: p15-oracle-080: the terminal, find, focus, focusRing and pane action families (the 47 ids of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose gen_actions.py family is focus and that scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json does not exclude; pane.screenshot is excluded). scripts/cmux-next/oracle/gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) reads this file (load_tuning) and writes one flat case per action. Each entry was read against its handler in Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextApp. Chrome reference: chrome/browser/ui/browser_focus_uitest.cc checks the focused view after each focus command (FocusLocationBar, focus traversal), so every directional and numbered pane move here waits on the focus facet (/focus/windows/0/model/pane, FocusCoordinator's reduced pane: p15-oracle-034) and the settled snapshot holds the layout focus, the responder and Ghostty's focused surface beside it. A run through action.run is a socket caller without focus: only ActionCatalog.focusActionIDs change the view, and a split it runs leaves focus in the launch's pane (FocusEvent::changes_view, cmux-tui/crates/cmux-focus-core/src/event.rs). Actions that change a terminal, its find bar, font, theme or pane appearance run in a second pane the case focuses first (setup-fresh), which the reset closes, so no case leaves text, a font size or a theme in the launch's terminal. Legacy bind handlers report action.done; refusals are control.unavailable. A `note` that starts with `divergence <key>` files a finding and names the task that fixes it (or the other family's case that files it); one that starts with `known failure (<task>)` names the open task whose fix makes the case green; `blocked` keeps a case out of the run until the task it names lands.
